dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: There is a vast collection of books here. I took a moment to browse through earlier, and found a good number worth reading.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: If you're not presently occupied, why not take a seat? I'll fetch a few good books and you can see if there are any you like.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: A fine book on a busy day can provide a much-needed escape, even if just for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: I have crossed paths with many a wicked foe in my time. When they come for you with knives in their hands and malice in their hearts, you cannot cower in fear, for this only emboldens them further.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: It is a hero's duty to seize victory with their sword, even in the most perilous of battles.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Although, things are different this time, because I'm not fighting alone... So let's watch each other's backs?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: This little book is truly exceptional. The gripping plot is one thing, but the characters, wow... they're so well rounded. They really break the mold.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #I can't thank you enough for inviting me to this incredible place, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: The next time I find a good novel, I'll make sure to get a copy for you.
